text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HasTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Humans(x) ::: x is a human.
Premises:
∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HasTeeth(x)) ::: Some mammals have teeth.
¬HasTeeth(platypus) ::: Platypuses have no teeth.
Platypus(platypus) ::: Platypuses are mammals.
HasTeeth(human) ::: Humans have teeth.
Conclusion:
Mammal(platypus) ∧ ¬HasTeeth(platypus) ::: Platypuses are mammals with no teeth.
